name: Tests
description: The test suites in your project's repositories (npm test scripts, Playwright, Vitest, Jest, Karma, dotnet test), run with one click, with their results, failing tests and history; Claude can run them too.

tools.description: List the test suites in the calling chat's project repositories (npm test scripts, Playwright, Vitest, Jest, Karma, dotnet test projects) with each suite's last result. Use before running tests, to pick the suite a change needs (a 'changed' suite runs only what the change touches).

Start one test suite (or join its run already going) and wait for it, at most `wait` seconds (default 90, max 100). When it finishes in time: passed/failed counts, the failing tests and the last lines of output. When it is still running (an end-to-end suite often takes 1-8 minutes): its run id and the output so far; then call addon_tests_wait with that id, again each time it says still running, until it is done. Never run the suite in your own shell instead: the user sees this run in the Tests view. Prefer the smallest suite that covers the change.

suite.description: The suite id from the list tool, e.g. npm:test or dotnet:tests/Shop.Tests/Shop.Tests.csproj

repo.description: The repository's path or name from the list tool (needed when several have the suite)

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the result before answering with the run id (0-100, default 90)

tools.description: Wait for a test run started with addon_tests_run (or in the Tests view), at most `wait` seconds (default 90, max 100). Returns the result like run (counts, failing tests, last lines of output) once it is done, or 'still running' with the output so far: then call it again with the same id. It never starts or stops a run.

id.description: The run id that addon_tests_run answered with

wait.description: Seconds to wait before answering (0-100, default 90)
